SELECT FROM operation_record o WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND (subject_id=#{userId} OR #{enterpriseReader}=TRUE)

SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND action='operation.read' AND status='ACTIVE' AND project_id IS NULL AND resource_kind='ENTERPRISE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY grant_id FOR UPDATE
